run_train_nl_code_search: run training for a natural language to code search model using BERT or RoBERTa
run_evaluate_nl_code_search: evaluate a trained NL-to-code search model and compute MRR scores
run_test_nl_code_search: test a trained NL-to-code search model and write predictions to a JSONL file
convert_examples_to_features: convert raw JSON examples into tokenized InputFeatures for code and docstring pairs
create_text_dataset: create a PyTorch TextDataset from a JSONL file of code and docstring examples
